title: Vue Action (Popup)
firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Click the toolbar icon to open the Vue popup
Edit src/action/ActionApp.vue and save to watch it update
useCases: A toolbar popup rendered by Vue
Single-file components compiled with no extra config
Starting point for Vue extensions with a popup

store.summary: Adds a toolbar popup to the browser with a simple Vue page.
versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the action-vue template. Not yet submitted to any store.
